interpretation: Inference is conditional on the prespecified synthetic generator and fixed family mix, not real-game strategic strength.
Japanese worlds are primary; paired English translations are secondary and never increase primary sample size.
Exact paired McNemar tests are adjusted by Holm across the two Japanese tasks. Statistical difference and practical 10-point difference are distinct.
Per-rate Wilson and conservative paired intervals preserve uncertainty at boundaries. Bootstrap intervals can degenerate and family-block intervals are robustness diagnostics.
Domain-family names are not independent reasoning structures; optional mechanism-block/leave-mechanism-out summaries diagnose concentration in shared formal operators.
Quality runs may share CPU resources. Their wall latencies are not a controlled performance benchmark.
All planned rows are required. Explicit execution failures are incorrect; missing rows are not silently excluded.
Coverage and conditional correctness use executable-command denominators; clarify cases are analyzed separately.
Suppressed calls are not accepted commands. Runtime/parse/invalid responses are not successful abstentions.
Fixed sample intervals condition on this synthetic command distribution. No interim stopping or threshold tuning is used.

runtime.backend: Torch CPU LM-head rows at official colon slots; official renderer/reduction/answer functions
runtime.timing_scope: Official validation/rendering, causal model forward at all answer slots, LM head and official probability decoding; checkpoint hashing, initialization and warmup excluded.
runtime.parity_scope: Same checkpoint, prompt IDs, positions, alias-max rule and probability formula as released vLLM plugin. vLLM server/kernel numerical parity is not measured.

memory.scope: Process-lifetime resource.ru_maxrss only; no growing sample history, model-only or VRAM claim.

settings.confidence_threshold: Official shipped native defaults, unchanged; suppressed_calls are never executed.
settings.decoding: temperature/top_k/top_p/seed are not exposed by the official Python API or C ABI; shipped native defaults unchanged. No claim of general deterministic inference.
settings.route: Local pinned libcactus loaded in the official Python worker; no hosted fallback, telemetry disabled, HF downloads offline.

ja.timing_scope: Official Cactus.complete() including stateless reset, native worker IPC, model inference and output/grounding parsing. Startup, file SHA checks and one warmup are separate. CPU affinity limits allowed cores; it does not imply the runtime uses that many threads.
ja.evaluation_scope: Frozen synthetic diagnostic command labels, not game win rate. Exact tool+typed arguments are scored. Unknown/ambiguous expected clarify is also safely handled by a clean successful abstention; runtime/parse errors do not count.
